title: FederationBank Core Banking and authority boundaries
purpose: Give LLMs a compact, authoritative interface to FederationBank Core/Retail banking architecture and the service boundaries that must not be collapsed: account authority, payment authority, Ledger monetary truth, physical cash custody, staff/teller channels, ATM recovery, and arm's-length Merchant Banking.
scope: Core/Retail Banking plus explicit boundary contracts to Staff/Teller/Branch Cash, ATM and Merchant Banking. This sphere does not make Merchant Banking part of Core.

provenance.claim: Core is intentionally three queue-addressable services under Channels request; backend authorities decide and execute.
